items.text_zh: 转发 @IGN：生化危机之父三上真司将在第30届D.I.C.E.大奖颁奖典礼上正式荣获名人堂奖…

items.text:
Huge congratulations to Shinji Mikami(@shinji_mikami) on being inducted into the D.I.C.E. Hall of Fame! 🏆

It's an absolute honor to discuss the future of game development and support his vision.

Please join us in looking forward to and supporting UNBOUND(@UNBND_Official )'s upcoming journey! ✨

#UNBOUND #ShinjiMikami #DICEAwards #HallOfFame

source_tweet.text:
Congratulations to @shinji_mikami  on his D.I.C.E. Hall of Fame induction! 🎉
三上真司さん、D.I.C.E. Hall of Fame 殿堂入りおめでとうございます！

We’re proud to celebrate this special moment with @suda_51 ! 👏
須田さんと共に、この特別な瞬間をお祝いします！

items.text_zh:
热烈祝贺三上真司（@shinji_mikami）入选D.I.C.E.名人堂！🏆

能与他探讨游戏开发的未来并支持他的愿景，是我莫大的荣幸。

请与我们一起期待并支持UNBOUND（@UNBND_Official）即将开启的旅程！✨

#UNBOUND #ShinjiMikami #DICEAwards #HallOfFame

items.text:
Good morning(こんにちは)~ The Tokyo Game Show has begun and the 7th Airborne Squad has landed. You can try out the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Stellar Blade hands-on at the event, so please visit the SEGA/ATLUS Booth and please give us infinite support 🙏
Also on Sunday, September 20! A special stage event featuring Kim Hyungtae, Director of Stellar Blade, is scheduled, so we ask for your continued interest and support. Who knows? Maybe he’s preparing something fun…??
📍SEGA/ATLUS Booth (Hall 4 / 04-N01)
📅Sep 17 - 21
